# smallstep_proxy (Resource)

Configuration to use a credential to route device traffic through a proxy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "smallstep_proxy" "corp_proxy" {
  name            = "CorpProxy"
  remote_address  = "proxy.example.com:3128"
  credentials     = [smallstep_credential.device.id]
  match_addresses = ["*.internal.example.com", "10.0.0.0/8"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (List of String) The UUIDs of credentials that the Smallstep agent will configure to use this proxy integration.
- `remote_address` (String) The address of the proxy server clients connect to.

### Optional

- `match_addresses` (List of String) Destination addresses that should be routed through the proxy.
- `name` (String) A human-friendly display name for this configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of this proxy configuration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import smallstep_proxy.corp_proxy 9e4bd9c1-2e6f-4d0b-8b1f-1c9d0a2b3c4d
```
